title: Make a folder-setup script idempotent
prompt: make_dirs.py fails or duplicates lines when run a second time. Change it so running it twice leaves exactly the same result as running it once: three folders and folders.txt listing each once.

setup.content:
"""Create the working folders and list them in folders.txt."""
from pathlib import Path

for name in ("inbox", "archive", "exports"):
    Path(name).mkdir()
    with open("folders.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(name + "\n")

files.content:
"""Grader: run make_dirs.py twice in a clean folder; the second run must change nothing."""
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path


def snapshot(root):
    return sorted((str(p.relative_to(root)), p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else b"<dir>") for p in root.rglob("*"))


def run(root):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "make_dirs.py"], cwd=root, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit(f"run failed with exit {r.returncode}")


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp)
    (root / "make_dirs.py").write_text(Path("make_dirs.py").read_text())
    run(root)
    once = snapshot(root)
    run(root)
    if snapshot(root) != once:
        sys.exit("second run changed the result")
    if any(not (root / n).is_dir() for n in ("inbox", "archive", "exports")):
        sys.exit("a folder is missing")
    if sorted((root / "folders.txt").read_text().split()) != ["archive", "exports", "inbox"]:
        sys.exit("folders.txt must list each folder once")
print("idempotent")

reference.content:
"""Create the working folders and list them in folders.txt; safe to run again."""
from pathlib import Path

NAMES = ("inbox", "archive", "exports")
for name in NAMES:
    Path(name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path("folders.txt").write_text("".join(n + "\n" for n in NAMES), encoding="utf-8")
